summary: UserFavLocations is a web-based interface designed to manage and view users' favorite locations within the HSPnet application. It supports viewing, modifying, and saving lists of included and not included locations.
purpose: To allow users to manage their list of favorite and non-favorite locations within the system.

fields.name: ViewAllMode
fields.description: Query string parameter to determine the view mode.

fields.name: StandAloneMode
fields.description: Query string parameter to determine if the application is running in standalone mode.

fields.name: lbNotIncluded
fields.description: List box for agencies not marked as favorites.

fields.name: lbIncluded
fields.description: List box for agencies marked as favorites.

workflows.name: LoadLists
steps: Retrieve agencies not marked as favorites.

workflows.name: cmdSave_Click
steps: Update user's favorite agencies based on lbIncluded.

business_rules: If StandAloneMode is not '1', it defaults to '0'.
validations: Ensure that StandAloneMode is either '0' or '1'.
conditions: When in standalone mode and ViewAllMode is '1', pnlViewALL is hidden.
When not in standalone mode, the opposite view panel is hidden.
system_behavior: Handles page load by setting up the HSPnet page and loading lists.
Updates user's favorite list on save.
Switches panels on view mode changes.
content_gaps: Detailed error handling is not described.
